description: Converts annotations between formats: 'native' (smart_labeler's own JSON), COCO, YOLO, and GeoPackage — plus a write-only 'sam3_exemplars' destination that turns hand-drawn smart_labeler boxes into the zero_shot_annotation step's exemplar prompt file. Runs inline in the backend, not as a Tapis job (conversion is data reshaping, not a compute job): during a run the engine performs the conversion in-process when the node's turn comes (engine/inline_steps.py), so a source produced by an upstream step is converted with this run's real data; the panel's 'Convert now' button does the same thing on demand at design time. GeoPackage output is NOT geo-referenced (no camera GPS/FOV model here) — it writes plain image-pixel-space geometry in one 'annotations' layer; use the 'geospatial' step for a real map-projected GeoPackage. YOLO assumes a flat label directory whose file stems match the image directory's file stems 1:1.

outputs.name: converted
outputs.description: Points at whatever 'path' was saved to — written by the run itself, so a downstream job can stage it as a fileInput. Actual content depends on to_format: a JSON file (native/coco), a directory of .txt + classes.txt (yolo), or a binary .gpkg file (geopackage) — the declared 'json_results' type is a placeholder, not a literal guarantee, since this step's output shape varies by user choice.

system.description: Tapis system the converted output is written to.

path.description: Destination Tapis path for the converted output — a file path for native/coco/geopackage, a directory path for yolo.

from_format.description: Source format. 'native' or 'coco' read from the wired 'annotations' input; 'yolo' reads 'annotations_dir' + 'images'; 'geopackage' reads 'annotations_gpkg'.

to_format.description: Destination format. 'coco' and 'yolo' additionally need the wired 'images' input, to read each referenced image's pixel dimensions. 'sam3_exemplars' writes the zero_shot_annotation step's PROMPT file rather than an annotation file — wire this step's 'converted' output into that step's 'annotation_file' input. It's write-only: nothing converts back OUT of it, so it can't be chosen as from_format.

text_prompts.description: Only used when to_format is 'sam3_exemplars'. Comma-separated free-text concepts written into the prompt file's top-level 'text_prompts'. Exemplar boxes only apply to the images they were drawn on, so these cover every OTHER image in the directory — with a single labeled image and no text prompts, most of a run has nothing to detect with.
